name: Backblaze Drive Stats
summary: Daily fleet-scale snapshots of hard drives and SSDs, including device identity, model, failure status, and raw and normalized S.M.A.R.T. statistics.

attributes.name: date
attributes.description: UTC date of the daily drive snapshot.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Drive serial number used to construct longitudinal device histories.

attributes.name: failure
attributes.description: One on the final day a drive is observed before a reported failure, otherwise zero.

attributes.name: smart_*_raw / smart_*_normalized
attributes.description: Raw and normalized S.M.A.R.T. attributes; availability varies by drive model and quarter.

notes: Data are partitioned by quarter to avoid requiring a full-history download.
The default variant is 2025-q1; specify another quarter explicitly when required.
Schema changes occur over time and S.M.A.R.T. attributes are highly sparse across drive models.
Backblaze permits derivative works but asks users not to sell the source data itself.
Quarterly archives are opt-in and are not downloaded by scripts/bootstrap.sh.
citation: Backblaze. Drive Stats: Hard Drive Test Data. https://www.backblaze.com/cloud-storage/resources/hard-drive-test-data
